thread:
sophia: Auditor wants a consolidated evidence bundle that shows Q1 RBAC changes tied to KMS rotations, plus the CVE-2025-0421 remediation timeline. Need verifiable chain-of-custody and a short control mapping for SOC2/ISO.

lee: Confirming window 2025-01-01 -> 2025-03-31. I'll export relevant CloudTrail records + Splunk slices.

ana: I'll pull the KMS rotation job outputs and the rotation fingerprint file. Rotation job id is rot-job-20250214 and fingerprints at gs://redwood-ops/rotations/2025-02-14/fingerprints-v2.json.

auditor_matt: Please ensure each file in the bundle has sha256, generated_by, generation_ts, and an explicit performed_by (user or service account). Also include the saved-search definition for Splunk and any SIEM alert IDs that correlate.

sophia: planned artifact list: 1) rbac_changes_2025Q1.csv (role change events with actor/ticket) 2) kms_rotations_2025Q1.json (rotation metadata + fingerprints) 3) deprovs_2025Q1.csv (service-account deprovs) 4) splunk_search_savedsearch_sec_rbac_kms_q1.json 5) siem_alerts_slice.json 6) cve-2025-0421-triage-notes.pdf 7) evidence-manifest.json.sig (GPG sig).

lee: Splunk example query I'll use: index=main source=aws:cloudtrail (eventName=UpdateRole OR eventName=DeleteRole OR eventName=AttachRolePolicy) | transaction sessionId maxspan=30m | search (eventName=AssumeRole OR eventName=GetObject OR eventName=StartSession) | table _time, user, eventName, srcIP, resources, requestParameters

lee: I'll export the CSV to s3://redwood-security/evidence/2025-Q1/exports/rbac_changes_2025Q1.csv and calculate sha256.

ana: KMS rotation metadata includes keyVersionId and fingerprint; rotation job writes envelope metadata with tag "evidence_bundle_id". I'll include runbook excerpt RB-ROT-EXCERPT-2025-02-14.txt in the bundle.

auditor_matt: Who will attest that previous key material was retired and not reused? Need a short statement from the rotation-runner service account owner or security lead.

sophia: I'll draft a one-paragraph attestation and have @lee sign the manifest (performed_by: lee).

deploy-bot: export process initiated: export_ref=exp-1765438901-01 status=queued

lee: For deprovs, export file will include ticket id and actor. s3 path s3://redwood-security/evidence/2025-Q1/exports/deprovs_2025Q1.csv (columns: ts, actor, target_sa, ticket). Ticket tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-7902

ana: Fingerprints file snippet: {"keyName":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rlk/cryptoKeys/qlk","keyVersion":"2","fingerprint":"b1c2d3e4f5..."} (I'll include full file in bundle).

auditor_matt: Also need access: auditors require read access for 72 hours. Provide either a presigned URL or a temporary IAM role with S3GetObject.

sophia: We'll publish a presigned URL to the private audit channel and add a short-lived IAM policy binding to role arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/auditor-read-72h. Presigned URL ephemeral link will be recorded in the chain-of-custody manifest.

lee: I'll include the Splunk saved search JSON saved_search_sec_rbac_kms_q1.json and note the savedsearch id. Also listing of associated alerts: ALERT-20250212-111, ALERT-20250215-009.

ana: I'll add the GCS rotation logs and runbook excerpt into the bundle and note GCS paths in the manifest for provenance.

sophia: please ensure we map each artifact to relevant controls (example mapping in control_map.csv: rbac_changes_2025Q1.csv -> SOC2 CC6.1, ISO A.9.2; kms_rotations_2025Q1.json -> SOC2 CC7.1, ISO A.10.1). Keep mappings concise.

auditor_matt: That mapping example is perfect. Also include a short README.txt in the bundle that explains how to verify signatures and checksums.

sophia: ETA for bundle and signed manifest: today EOD PST. I'll post presigned link to private audit room when upload completes.

deploy-bot: export job started: export_ref=exp-1765438901-01 status=running

lee: will add performed_by fields for each export and the exact commands used to generate CSVs in audit_commands.txt.

ana: rotation fingerprint file and runbook excerpt added to staging.

sophia: thanks team — keep messages minimal in the bundle per auditor preference. I'll assemble evidence-bundle name evidence-q1-2025-rbac-kms-triage.tar.gz and sign the manifest.

auditor_matt: Thanks, looking forward to the bundle and the control_map.csv.
summary: Collaboration to produce a signed evidence bundle linking Q1 2025 RBAC changes, KMS rotations, deprovs, and the CVE-2025-0421 triage. Team will export Splunk/CloudTrail records, include rotation fingerprints and runbook excerpts, produce GPG-signed manifest, and provide short-lived auditor access with a control mapping.
